Metabolic pathways inferred from the Prokka annotations with MinPath. Commands for this step were run in `minpath/`.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
# Bash chunks are a record of commands you ran in the Terminal. Knitting shows
# them but doesn't run them again.
knitr::opts_hooks$set(engine = function(options) {
  if (options$engine == "bash") options$eval <- FALSE
  options
})
```

Organize ID
```{bash}
head ../prokka/metabat.7/metabat.7.tsv
head ../prokka/metabat.7/metabat.7.tsv | awk -F '\t' '{print $1,$5}'
head ../prokka/metabat.7/metabat.7.tsv | awk -F '\t' '$5{print $1,$5}'
cat ../prokka/metabat.7/metabat.7.tsv | awk -F '\t' '$5{OFS="\t";print $1,$5}' | grep -v '^locus'
cat ../prokka/metabat.7/metabat.7.tsv | awk -F '\t' '$5{OFS="\t";print $1,$5}' | grep -v '^locus' > metabat.5.ec
minpath -ec metabat.7.ec -report metabat.7.ec.report -details metabat.7.ec.details
tail ../prokka/slurm-493.out
```

Run minpath on the bins
```{bash}
while read bin;do 
  cat ../prokka/$bin/${bin}.tsv | awk -F '\t' '$5{printf("%s\t%s\n", $1,$5)}' | grep -v '^locus' > ${bin}.ec 
done < ../checkm/bbd_topbins.txt

while read bin;do 
  minpath -ec ${bin}.ec -report ${bin}.ec.report -details ${bin}.ec.details
done < ../checkm/bbd_topbins.txt
```

Look at pathway PWY-101
```{bash}
grep 'PWY-101' *.ec.report
```

Look at pathway PWY-5360
```{bash}
grep 'PWY-5360' *.ec.report
```
